### Read and format dataset
```{r reading_data}

############################
# Read in sample data
############################

if(long.compute){
  
  ########################
  # Read in tumour data
  ########################
  
  # List directories
  input.dir <- list.dirs("data/Tumour")
  input.dir <- input.dir[-1]
  
  # Create name variable
  file.names <- gsub("data/Tumour/", "", input.dir)
  
  
  # Read in samples
  for (i in seq_along(input.dir)){
    assign(file.names[i], Seurat::Read10X(input.dir[i]))
  }
  
  ########################
  # Read in healthy data
  ########################
  
  # List directories
  input.dir <- list.dirs("data/Adjacent_normal")
  input.dir <- input.dir[-1]
  
  # Create name variable
  file.names <- gsub("data/Adjacent_normal/", "", input.dir)
  
  
  # Read in samples
  for (i in seq_along(input.dir)){
    assign(file.names[i], Seurat::Read10X(input.dir[i]))
  }
  
}

```

### Create seurat object
```{r create_Seurat_object}


if(long.compute){
  load_data <- function(data.input, species.ori = "human", project.name = NULL){
    
    s.object <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = data.input,
                                   min.cells = 3, 
                                   project = project.name,
                                   min.genes = 200)
    
    if (species.ori == "mouse") {
      pat <- "^mt-"
    }else if (species.ori == "human"){
      pat <- "^MT-"
    }
    
    s.object <- PercentageFeatureSet(s.object,
                                     pattern = pat,
                                     col.name = "percent.mt")
    
    return(s.object)
  }
  
  for(i in 1:4){
    
    # Tumour samples into seurat objects
    input.data <- eval(parse(text = paste0("R", i, "_T")))
    
    seurat.name <- paste0("Tumour.", i, ".seurat")
    
    
    assign(seurat.name, load_data(input.data, 
                                  species.ori = "human", 
                                  project.name = paste0("Tumour_", i)))
    
    
    
    # Normal samples into seurat objects
    input.data <- eval(parse(text = paste0("R", i, "_N")))
    
    seurat.name <- paste0("Normal.", i, ".seurat")
    
    assign(seurat.name, load_data(input.data, 
                                  species.ori = "human", 
                                  project.name = paste0("Normal_", i)))
    
  }
  
  
  
  
  # Make a list of seurat objects
  seurat.list <- c(Normal.1.seurat, 
                   Normal.2.seurat,
                   Normal.3.seurat,
                   Normal.4.seurat,
                   Tumour.1.seurat,
                   Tumour.2.seurat,
                   Tumour.3.seurat,
                   Tumour.4.seurat)
  
  names(seurat.list) <- c("Normal_1", "Normal_2", "Normal_3", "Normal_4",
                          "Tumour_1", "Tumour_2", "Tumour_3", "Tumour_4")
  
  
  
  saveRDS(seurat.list, "Exported_RDS_files/Seurat_list.rds")
  
  
  # remove single seurat objects and other large data
  
  rm(R1_N, R2_N, R3_N, R4_N, R1_T, R2_T, R3_T, R4_T, input.data,
     Normal.1.seurat, Normal.2.seurat, Normal.3.seurat, Normal.4.seurat,
     Tumour.1.seurat, Tumour.2.seurat, Tumour.3.seurat, Tumour.4.seurat)
  
}
```


### Format metadata
```{r format_metadata}


if(long.compute){

############################
# Formatting metadata
############################

# Cell type info
all.cells <- read_xlsx("annotations/Fig1_all_cell_annoation_info.xlsx")
all.cells <- as.data.frame(all.cells)

head(all.cells)

colnames(all.cells) <- c("cells", "cell_type")

all.cells$sampleID <- gsub("_.*", "", all.cells$cells)

unique(all.cells$sampleID)


# Formatting of EC subcluster metadata
EC.subcluster <- read_xlsx("annotations/Fig2_EC_subclustering_annoation_info.xlsx")
EC.subcluster <- as.data.frame(EC.subcluster)

head(EC.subcluster)

colnames(EC.subcluster) <- c("cells", "EC_subcluster")

EC.subcluster$sampleID <- gsub("_.*", "", EC.subcluster$cells)

unique(EC.subcluster$sampleID)


# Loop over seurat list and apply metadata

for(i in seq_along(seurat.list)){
  
  # Rename cell ID in seurat objects
  current.names <- rownames(seurat.list[[i]]@meta.data)
  
  new.names <- gsub("-1", "", current.names)
  
  if(i <= 4){
    new.names <- paste0("control", i, "_", new.names)
  }else if(i > 4){
    j <- i-4
    new.names <- paste0("tumour", j, "_", new.names)
  }
  
  seurat.list[[i]] <- Seurat::RenameCells(seurat.list[[i]], 
                                          new.names = new.names)
  
  
  # filter metadata for seurat object in question
  if(i <= 4){
    sample.id <- paste0("control", i)
  }else if(i > 4){
    j <- i-4
    sample.id <- paste0("tumour", j)
  }
  
  ##############################
  # Add cell type metadata
  ##############################
  
  # Cell Type metadata
  Celltype.meta <- 
    all.cells %>%
    dplyr::filter(sampleID == sample.id)
  
  # make metadata into a named vector 
  celltype.vector <- Celltype.meta$cell_type
  names(celltype.vector) <- Celltype.meta$cells
  
  # add metadata
  # add meta data
  seurat.list[[i]] <- AddMetaData(seurat.list[[i]], 
                                  metadata = celltype.vector, 
                                  col.name = "cell_type")
  
  # rename non-mapped na.values to unknown
  na.logic <- is.na(seurat.list[[i]]@meta.data$cell_type)
  seurat.list[[i]]@meta.data$cell_type[na.logic] <- "Unknown"
  
  
  ##############################
  # Add EC subcluster metadata
  ##############################
  
  # EC subcluster metadata
  EC.subcluster.meta <- 
    EC.subcluster %>%
    dplyr::filter(sampleID == sample.id)
  
  # make metadata into a named vector 
  ECsubcluster.vector <- EC.subcluster.meta$EC_subcluster
  names(ECsubcluster.vector) <- EC.subcluster.meta$cells
  
  # add metadata
  # add meta data
  seurat.list[[i]] <- AddMetaData(seurat.list[[i]], 
                                  metadata = ECsubcluster.vector, 
                                  col.name = "EC_subcluster")
  
  
  
  
  # rename non-mapped na.values to unknown
  na.logic <- is.na(seurat.list[[i]]@meta.data$EC_subcluster)
  seurat.list[[i]]@meta.data$EC_subcluster[na.logic] <- "Non_EC"
  
  rm(ECsubcluster.vector, celltype.vector)
  
}



# remove other large data 
rm(all.cells, Celltype.meta, EC.subcluster, EC.subcluster.meta)


# Export data
saveRDS(seurat.list, "Exported_RDS_files/Seurat_list.rds")


}

```


## QC and Filter {.tabset}

### QC & filter

```{r QC_and_filter}

if(long.compute){
  
  for(i in seq_along(seurat.list)){
    
    # Create output dir
    output.path <- paste0("output/QC/QC_", names(seurat.list)[i])
    
    
    if(!dir.exists(output.path)){
      dir.create(output.path, 
                 recursive = TRUE)}
    
    
    # Plot QC metrics 
    
    # nFeature & nCount & Mito
    print(
      VlnPlot(seurat.list[[i]], 
              features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), 
              group.by = "cell_type",
              pt.size = 0.1)
    )
    
    dev.copy(pdf,  paste0(output.path, "/QC_nFeature_nCount_RNA_percentMito.pdf"))
    dev.off()
    
    # Mito
    print(
      VlnPlot(seurat.list[[i]], 
              features = "percent.mt", 
              group.by = "cell_type",
              pt.size = 0.1)
    )
    
    dev.copy(pdf,  paste0(output.path, "/QC_RNA_percentMito.pdf"))
    dev.off()
    
  }
  
  
  #min.nFeature <- 400
  #max.nFeature <- 7500
  #max.nCount <- 50000
  #max.Percent.Mt <- 15
  
  #seurat.list <- lapply(seurat.list, 
  #                     FUN = subset,
  #                    subset = nFeature_RNA > min.nFeature & nFeature_RNA < max.nFeature & nCount_RNA < max.nCount & percent.mt < max.Percent.Mt)
  
  
  
  ####################################
  # filter by only keeping cells with annotation as these were in the original published paper 
  ####################################
  
  for(i in seq_along(seurat.list)){
    
    Idents(seurat.list[[i]]) <- seurat.list[[i]]@meta.data$cell_type
    cell.types <- unique(seurat.list[[i]]@meta.data$cell_type)
    keep.logic <- !grepl("Unknown", cell.types)
    cell.types.keep <- cell.types[keep.logic]
    
    seurat.list[[i]] <- subset(seurat.list[[i]],
                               idents = cell.types.keep)
    
  }
  
  
  
  
  for(i in seq_along(seurat.list)){
    
    # output.dir
    output.path <- paste0("output/QC/QC_", names(seurat.list)[i])
    
    # After filtering
    print(
      VlnPlot(seurat.list[[i]],
              features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
              group.by = "cell_type",
              pt.size = 0.1)
    )
    
    dev.copy(pdf,  paste0(output.path, "/QC_nFeature_nCount_RNA_percentMito_Postfiltering.pdf"))
    dev.off()
    
  }
  
  
  # Post-filtering metrics
  seurat.list
  
  
  # Save filtered dataset
  saveRDS(seurat.list, "Exported_RDS_files/Seurat_list.rds")
  
  
}

```

## Integrate datasets {.tabset}

### Integrate data

```{r Integrate_data}

if(long.compute){
  
  
  # Integrate datasets
  
  # Select features
  integration.features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = seurat.list, 
                                                    nfeatures = 4000)
  
  # Prep dataset
  integrated.seurat <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = seurat.list, 
                                          anchor.features = integration.features)
  
  # perform PCA analysis
  integrated.seurat <- lapply(X = integrated.seurat, 
                              FUN = Seurat::RunPCA,
                              features = integration.features)
  
  
  # Find integration anchors
  integration.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = integrated.seurat, 
                                                anchor.features = integration.features,
                                                normalization.method = 'SCT',
                                                reference = c(1, 5), # use 1 normal and 1 tumour sample as reference
                                                reduction = "rpca", # rpca is more conservative, best for datasets which may not overlap alot
                                                k.anchor = 20) # increases strength of alignment
  
  # Integrate dataset
  integrated.seurat <- IntegrateData(anchorset = integration.anchors, 
                                     normalization.method = 'SCT')
  
  
  # Basic overview of data
  integrated.seurat # 57127 genes and 50710 cells 
  
  #seurat.list[[1]] # 19912 cells
  #seurat.list[[2]] # 12115 cells
  #seurat.list[[3]] # 12040 cells
  #seurat.list[[4]] # 13060 cells
  
  # clear memory
    gc()
    
    
    # add some metadat to object
    integrated.seurat@meta.data$disease <- gsub("_.*", "", integrated.seurat@meta.data$orig.ident)
    integrated.seurat@meta.data$SampleID <- integrated.seurat@meta.data$orig.ident
    
    
    # Save files 
    saveRDS(integrated.seurat, file = "Exported_RDS_files/integrated_seurat.rds")
    
    saveRDS(integration.anchors, file = "Exported_RDS_files/integration.anchors.rds")
    saveRDS(integration.features, file = "Exported_RDS_files/integration.features.rds")
    
    
  # Remove unneeded data
  rm(integration.anchors, integration.features)
  
  
  
  
}

```



## Unbiased Clustering {.tabset}

### Clustering
```{r PCA_and_cluster_identification}

if(long.compute){

################################
# PCA and cluster identification
################################


# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(42)

DefaultAssay(integrated.seurat) <- "integrated"
Idents(integrated.seurat) <- integrated.seurat@meta.data$cell_type


# Calculate PCA
integrated.seurat <- Seurat::RunPCA(integrated.seurat, 
                                    npcs = 20, 
                                    verbose = TRUE, 
                                    rev.pca = TRUE,
                                    seed.use = 42)

# Find neighbours
integrated.seurat <- Seurat::FindNeighbors(integrated.seurat, 
                                           dims = 1:20)

# Find clusters
integrated.seurat <- Seurat::FindClusters(integrated.seurat, 
                                          resolution = 0.1)



# Plot PCA
# Create output dir
output.path <- paste0("output/figures/PCA")

if(!dir.exists(output.path)){
  dir.create(output.path, 
             recursive = TRUE)}


PCAPlot(integrated.seurat, 
        dims = c(1, 2),
        pt.size = 2, 
        group.by = "SampleID")


dev.copy(pdf,  paste0(output.path, "/PCA_dim1_vs_2.pdf"))
dev.off()


PCAPlot(integrated.seurat, 
        dims = c(2, 3),
        pt.size = 2, 
        group.by = "SampleID")


dev.copy(pdf,  paste0(output.path, "/PCA_dim2_vs_3.pdf"))
dev.off()




#################################################################
# Determine statistically significant principal components
#################################################################


# get output.dir
output.path <- paste0("output/figures/PCA")

ElbowPlot(integrated.seurat,
          ndims = 20)


dev.copy(pdf,  paste0(output.path, "/PC_elbowplot.pdf"))
dev.off()

}

```


### UMAP and tSNE dim Reduction
```{r Dim_reduction}

if(long.compute){
# Calculate UMAP
integrated.seurat <- Seurat::RunUMAP(integrated.seurat, 
                                     reduction = "pca",
                                     dims = 1:20,
                                     umap.method = "uwot", 
                                     n.neighbors = 45, # 5 to 50 // 45
                                     min.dist = 0.5, # Sensible values are in the range 0.001 to 0.5 // 0.5
                                     seed.use = 42)

# Plot UMAP
# Create output dir
output.path <- paste0("output/figures/UMAP")

if(!dir.exists(output.path)){
  dir.create(output.path, 
             recursive = TRUE)}



# New clusters
UMAPPlot(integrated.seurat, 
         group.by = "seurat_clusters")


dev.copy(pdf,  paste0(output.path, "/UMAP_seurat_clusters.pdf"))
dev.off()


# Sample ID
UMAPPlot(integrated.seurat, 
         group.by = "SampleID")


dev.copy(pdf,  paste0(output.path, "/UMAP_SampleID.pdf"))
dev.off()

# Cell type
UMAPPlot(integrated.seurat, 
         group.by = "cell_type")


dev.copy(pdf,  paste0(output.path, "/UMAP_cell_type.pdf"))
dev.off()

# By disease
UMAPPlot(integrated.seurat, 
         split.by = "disease")


dev.copy(pdf,  paste0(output.path, "/UMAP_disease.pdf"))
dev.off()


# By EC_subcluster
UMAPPlot(integrated.seurat, 
         group.by = "EC_subcluster")

dev.copy(pdf,  paste0(output.path, "/UMAP_EC_subcluster.pdf"))
dev.off()


# Save dataset with dim reduction
saveRDS(integrated.seurat, "Exported_RDS_files/integrated_seurat.rds")


}
```
